page.overview:
Who is He Xing?

He Xing grew up in a desolate set of canyons in the northern Earth Kingdom with a family of expert beast handlers who protected the other families in the canyon from all manner of threats. He Xing was given an important role within the family when he was chosen to become the warden, a justiciar and lawkeeper.

After the Fire Nation scattered his family during the Hundred Year War, He Xing decided to keep up his duties as Warden in the world at large, traveling to enforce law and bring forth peace and justice according to his family's traditions. He eventually began to hear of the struggles surrounding the pirates in the Fire Nation's waters and made them his focus.

He Xing had both a sad and haughty demeanor, and always took his duties seriously.

He Xing was skilled at pummeling boulders of earth at his opponents. He was also a skilled animal handler like the rest of his family, and rode a mongoose lizard.
